rice.src: Philippine Statistics Authority - Price Situationer of Selected Agricultural Commodities (national average retail prices)
rice.quote: At the national level, a kilogram of well milled rice had an average retail price of PhP 56.25 during the second phase of October 2026 (15 to 17 October 2026).

sugar.src: Philippine Statistics Authority - Price Situationer of Selected Agricultural Commodities (national average retail prices)
sugar.quote: At the national level, refined sugar had an average retail price of PhP 82.08 per kilogram during the second phase of October 2026.

cooking_oil.src: Philippine Statistics Authority - Price Situationer of Selected Agricultural Commodities (national average retail prices)
cooking_oil.quote: At the national level, cooking oil had an average retail price of PhP 202.06 per liter during the second phase of November 2026.

chicken.src: Philippine Statistics Authority - Price Situationer of Selected Agricultural Commodities (national average retail prices)
chicken.quote: An average retail price of PhP 213.43 per kilogram at the national level was reported for dressed chicken during the first phase of June 2026.
